name: YouTube Skillbox
tagline: Evidence-backed YouTube audit — channel, keywords & content fixes in one app
description: Paste your channel URL and get a research-through-retention audit, powered by the open-source YouTube Skillbox engine. Snapshot, outliers, SEO scorecard, keyword volume & competition, a GO / MAYBE / SKIP verdict, plus an AI content studio (hooks, titles, chapters, SEO). Every number is labelled MEASURED / INFERRED — no vibes, no fake rankings. Zero user API keys: built on yt-dlp + free public endpoints, MIT licensed.
